title: $100 a month into Facebook since 2012 is now worth this
caption:
$100 every month into Facebook since 2012.
Today that would be worth about {dca:META:2012-05-18} (price growth only, no dividends).
comment: Could you put away $100 a month? 👇
sources: Facebook price history, Yahoo Finance (split-adjusted), at render time

scenes.say: One hundred dollars a month, into Facebook, starting in 2012.
Back then, Facebook was a social network.
Today, those monthly payments would be worth about {dca:META:2012-05-18}.
Small, boring, every month. That's how wealth is built.
